interface.longDescription:
Practice chess with ChatGPT using an interactive board, legal move validation, and a stable game ID. Track elapsed game and player time, move counts, and move-by-move timing. Ask for progressive hints and position-aware explanations from a bundled collection of authored chess lessons and standard opening continuations. Replay supplied PGN, an existing game snapshot, or a continuation from a custom FEN; step, jump, or autoplay with optional recorded move timing and discuss the selected position with ChatGPT.

This release uses anonymous, best-effort app memory on Vercel. Games may become unavailable before their seven-day expiry if instances restart or records are evicted. It has no engine evaluation or professional-strength guarantee. Imported historical metadata is supplied by the user and not independently verified.
defaultPrompt: Start a chess game and help me understand the ideas behind each move.
Give me a gentle hint about my current position without revealing a move.
Replay my supplied PGN from a later position and explain the strategy.

publication.release_notes: Initial submission draft: interactive legal chess games with stable UUIDs, elapsed timers, move tracking, authored guidance, and PGN/FEN replay with optional recorded timing.
